title: JSFL: addNewLine, breakApart, flatten/smooth/straighten stubs, clipCopy/clipPaste stubs, timeline.name, publishProfiles stubs
description:
Add to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

REAL implementations:
1. doc.addNewLine(startPoint: {x,y}, endPoint: {x,y}): void - creates a line (ShapeDisplayObject with a path from start to end). Look at how addNewRectangle creates a shape and follow the same pattern with a line path.
2. doc.breakApart(): void - call breakApart() from @flash/core/shapeOps if it exists. If function signature unclear, add a console.warn stub.

STUBS (console.warn):
3. doc.flatten(): void
4. doc.smooth(): void
5. doc.straighten(): void
6. doc.crop(): void
7. doc.intersect(): void
8. doc.punch(): void
9. doc.union(): void
10. doc.clipCopy(): void - warn 'use fl.clipCopyFrames'
11. doc.clipCut(): void - stub
12. doc.clipPaste(bInPlace?: boolean): void - stub
13. doc.paste(bInPlace?: boolean): void - stub

GETTERS (return empty/default values):
14. fl.clipboardContents - getter on JsflFl returning null
15. doc.currentPublishProfile: string - getter returning 'Default'
16. doc.publishProfiles: string[] - getter returning ['Default']

ON JsflTimeline:
17. name: string - getter that returns the scene name for the current timeline. Access the scene from state.doc.scenes[state.sceneIndex].name or similar.
